title: Probe score-and-fusion matrix to stabilize autoscaling and multi-region failover
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Background:
The autoscaler and regional failover systems currently treat readiness/liveness probe failures as binary signals. This produces sharp capacity shifts or premature circuit-breaker tripping during transient upstream blips (noisy KV cache, short gpu preemption, thundering similar requests), which in turn burns SLO budgets and causes cascading cross-region failovers.

Goal:
Design and implement a probe "score-and-fuse" matrix: a continuous scoring layer that combines multiple probe signals (application-level readiness, latency tail probes, synthetic in-region pings, per-request success rate) into a single stability score per instance and per-region. Use the score to drive:
- Autoscaler decisions (hysteresis and derating based on score distributions)
- Circuit breaker escalation (gradual degrade, not immediate open)
- Load-shedding policy triggers (selective shedding by request-shape rather than whole-instance blacklisting)

Proposed approach:
1) Define probe primitives and score weights: capture probe latency percentiles, error-rate windows (1m/5m/1h), p99 serving latency probes, and synthetic cross-region health checks.
2) Implement a lightweight scoring function in the health aggregation service that outputs a 0-100 stability score per instance every 10s. The scoring function will be parameterized by model-serving metadata (seq length distribution, batching mode) and can be tuned per workload.
3) Aggregation: compute region-level score distributions (median, 75th, 95th). Autoscaler to use distribution thresholds instead of single-instance readiness gating.
4) Circuit breaker: add a multi-stage breaker (degrade -> partial-open -> open) driven by score quantiles and SLO burn-rate signals. Include automatic rollback conditions when score recovers.
5) Load-shedding: when a region is in degrade stage, apply request-shape-aware shedding (e.g., shed long-context/low-value jobs first) and enable prefix-KV-caching quick-paths.
6) Observability and tuning UI: surface score histogram, per-model templates, and suggested parameter sets in Console.

Telemetry and metrics to add:
- instance.stability_score (gauge)
- region.stability_quantiles (gauge set: p50/p75/p95)
- scaler.decision_event (counter with reason tags: score_drop/queue_backlog/pod_eviction)
- circuit_breaker.state_transitions (counter)
- shed.policy_applied (counter with request-shape tag)

Acceptance criteria:
- New stability score computed in prod staging for all serving clusters for 2 weeks.
- Autoscaler respects region.p95 stability threshold and reduces scaling flapping by >= 60% in synthetic chaos runs.
- Circuit breaker transitions show progressive degrade states in at least 2 controlled canaries instead of full open events.
- Customer-facing SLO burn-rate reduces during transient node noise in weekly chaos tests.

Rollout plan:
- Spike (2 w): implement scoring prototype in canary cluster. (Spike done 2026-03-03).
- Field test (3 w): enable scoring read-only in prod-staging and collect telemetry.
- Canary (2 w): enable autoscaler to consult scores in 2 non-critical regions with rollback flag.
- Gradual ramp (4 w): expand to primary regions, enable load-shedding rules and circuit-breaker policy.

Runbook excerpt (for oncall):
- If regions enter 'degrade' unexpectedly: check instance.stability_score heatmap, recent kernel preemption events, and batch queue lengths.
- For false positives: temporarily set autoscaler.score_derate_pct to 30% and open a tracing ticket.
- To force restore: trigger circuit_breaker.force_reset for broken region and roll traffic to fallback region.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: scoring function misweights signals and hides real failures. Mitigation: start read-only telemetry and compare against incident ground-truth for 2 weeks before enforcement.
- Risk: increased control-plane overhead. Mitigation: keep scoring computation O(1) per instance and limit retention to 10m raw samples with rollups to 1h.

comments: 2026-03-01: Spike complete. Prototype scoring function implemented in canary cluster; synthetic noise test shows promising separation between transient and sustained failures.
2026-03-03: Design review with platform and SRE. Agreed on multi-stage circuit breaker and conservative defaults. Need telemetry tags for model and batch-mode.
2026-03-08: Implementation of scorer is now emitting instance.stability_score for staging. Observability dashboards added to Console mock.
2026-03-10: Began canary config to allow autoscaler to read scores in two non-critical regions behind a feature flag. Not enabling load-shedding yet.
2026-03-10: Blocking item - need security review signoff for cross-region synthetic probes because they touch customer VPC endpoints (ticket sent to security).
